items.title: 11.1.1 Domains and Ranges of Tangent and Cotangent Functions (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein sine aur cosine ka domain poora \(\mathbb{R}\) nikla tha, kyun ke un mein koi division nahin tha. Aaj tangent aur cotangent ki baari hai, aur yahan kahani thori badalti hai: yeh dono fractions (kasr) hain. Fraction mein sab se bari pabandi kya hoti hai? Denominator (neeche wala number) zero nahin ho sakta. Bas isi ek rule se aaj ka poora sabaq nikal aata hai.
Kitab kehti hai: Figure 11.1 se. To pehle figure dobara saamne rakh lete hain.

blocks.alt: Unit circle with centre O at the origin, axes X prime X and Y prime Y. It meets the axes at A(1, 0), B(0, 1), C(minus 1, 0) and D(0, minus 1). The terminal side OP, drawn as an arrow, makes angle theta with OX; P(x, y) is on the circle, M is the foot of the perpendicular PM on OX, OM = x and MP = y.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.1 (repeated from 11.1): unit circle with P(x, y) on the terminal side of θ (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Figure mein \(P(x, y)\) unit circle par hai, is liye:
\[\tan\theta = \dfrac{y}{x}, \qquad \cot\theta = \dfrac{x}{y}\]
Tangent ke denominator mein \(x\) hai, cotangent ke denominator mein \(y\). Is liye aaj ka kaam yeh hai: woh angles dhoondo jahan denominator zero ho jata hai, aur unhein \(\mathbb{R}\) mein se nikaal do. Jo bachega wahi domain hai.

(i) Tangent function
\[\tan\theta = \frac{y}{x},\quad x \ne 0\]
\(\Rightarrow\) terminal side \(\overrightarrow{OP}\) ko \(OY\) ya \(OY'\) (yani \(Y\)-axis) par nahin aana chahiye
\[\Rightarrow \theta \ne \pm\frac{\pi}{2}, \pm\frac{3\pi}{2}, \pm\frac{5\pi}{2}, \ldots\]
\[\Rightarrow \theta \ne (2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2},\ \text{where } n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Tangent function ka domain \(= \mathbb{R} - \{x \mid x = (2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2},\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\}\)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein tangent ke liye mana angles wali doosri line (aur 11.1.2 mein bhi yahi line) gadmad chhapi hai: \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\) aur \(\frac{5\pi}{2}\) ek doosre par charh gaye hain aur signs ghalat jagah hain. Sahi line yeh hai: \(\theta \ne \pm\frac{\pi}{2}, \pm\frac{3\pi}{2}, \pm\frac{5\pi}{2}, \ldots\), jaise upar likha hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(x = 0\) ka matlab \(Y\)-axis kyun? Unit circle par sirf do points aise hain jin ka \(x = 0\) hai: \(B(0, 1)\) (oopar) aur \(D(0, -1)\) (neeche). Terminal side \(B\) par pohanchti hai \(\frac{\pi}{2}\), \(\frac{5\pi}{2}\), \(-\frac{3\pi}{2}\), ... par, aur \(D\) par \(\frac{3\pi}{2}\), \(-\frac{\pi}{2}\), ... par.
Ghaur karein: yeh sab \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) ke odd multiples (taaq guna) hain: \(1, 3, 5, \ldots\) guna \(\frac{\pi}{2}\), plus ya minus. Har odd number ko \(2n + 1\) likh sakte hain (\(n = 0\) se 1, \(n = 1\) se 3, \(n = -1\) se \(-1\)). Is liye poori lambi list ko chhota kar ke \((2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2}\), \(n \in \mathbb{Z}\) likh dete hain. \(\mathbb{Z}\) ka matlab integers (poore number: ..., -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, ...).
Dhyan dein: domain mein "\(x\)" likha hai to ghabraiye mat; yahan \(x\) sirf angle ke liye ek naam hai, \(\theta\) ki jagah.

Ab range. Agar \(y = 1\) ho to \(\tan\theta = \frac{1}{x}\); jab \(x \to 0\) (yani \(x\) zero ke qareeb jata hai), \(\frac{1}{x} \to \pm\infty\), is liye tangent function ki range \(= \mathbb{R}\) = real numbers ka set.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kitab ki yeh chhoti si daleel (argument) zara khol kar dekhte hain. Jab \(P\) point \(B(0, 1)\) ki taraf barhta hai to \(y\) taqreeban \(1\) ho jata hai aur \(x\) zero ke qareeb. Ek bare number ko bohat chhote number se divide karein to jawab bohat bara banta hai. Calculator par check kijiye: \(\tan 89^{\circ} \approx 57.3\), \(\tan 89.9^{\circ} \approx 573\), \(\tan 89.99^{\circ} \approx 5730\). \(Y\)-axis ki doosri taraf \(x\) negative hai, to \(\tan\theta\) bohat bara negative number ban jata hai.
Ek aur aasan tareeqa: \(\frac{y}{x}\) line \(OP\) ka slope (dhalaan) hai. Jab \(OP\) \(X\)-axis se \(Y\)-axis ki taraf ghoomti hai to slope \(0\) se shuru ho kar jitna chahein utna bara ho jata hai; doosri taraf har negative value leta hai. Seedhi road ka slope 0, chadhai wali road ka zyada, aur deewar jaisi seedhi khari line ka slope "bohat zyada" yani undefined. Is liye \(\tan\theta\) har real value leta hai; na koi oopar ki hadd hai na neeche ki.

(ii) Cotangent function
Figure 11.1 se
\[\cot\theta = \frac{x}{y},\quad y \ne 0\]
\(\Rightarrow\) terminal side \(\overrightarrow{OP}\) ko \(OX\) ya \(OX'\) (yani \(X\)-axis) par nahin aana chahiye
\[\Rightarrow \theta \ne 0, \pm\pi, \pm 2\pi, \ldots\]
\[\Rightarrow \theta \ne n\pi,\ \text{where } n \in \mathbb{Z}\]
Cotangent function ka domain \(= \mathbb{R} - \{x \mid x = n\pi,\ n \in \mathbb{Z}\}\)
Agar \(x = 1\) ho to \(\cot\theta = \frac{1}{y}\); jab \(y \to 0\), \(\frac{1}{y} \to \pm\infty\), is liye cotangent function ki range \(= \mathbb{R}\) = real numbers ka set.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Cotangent mein denominator \(y\) hai. \(y = 0\) wale points \(A(1, 0)\) aur \(C(-1, 0)\) hain, yani \(X\)-axis. Terminal side wahan \(0, \pi, 2\pi, -\pi, \ldots\) par pohanchti hai: \(\pi\) ka har multiple, \(n\pi\). Is baar odd ya even ki koi qaid nahin, kyun ke \(X\)-axis par har aadhe chakkar (\(\pi\)) baad wapas aate hain.
In angles ke qareeb \(y\) bohat chhota aur \(x\) taqreeban \(\pm 1\), is liye \(\cot\theta = \frac{x}{y}\) jitna chahein bara (positive ya negative) ho jata hai. Aur \(\theta = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\cot\theta = 0\). Yani cotangent bhi har real value leta hai.

blocks.caption: Is sabaq ka hamara khulasa (n koi bhi integer).

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Kya \(\tan\frac{7\pi}{2}\) ki koi value hai? \(\frac{7\pi}{2} = 7 \times \frac{\pi}{2}\), aur 7 odd hai (\(n = 3\) se \(2n + 1 = 7\)). Is liye yeh angle \(Y\)-axis par hai aur \(\tan\frac{7\pi}{2}\) undefined hai.
Aur \(\cot\frac{7\pi}{2}\)? Yahan \(y = -1 \ne 0\) aur \(x = 0\), is liye \(\cot\frac{7\pi}{2} = \frac{0}{-1} = 0\). Bilkul theek value hai!

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Batayein kaun se angles tangent ke domain mein nahin hain: \(\frac{\pi}{4}, \frac{\pi}{2}, \pi, -\frac{3\pi}{2}\).
\(\frac{\pi}{4}\): \(\tan\frac{\pi}{4} = 1\), theek hai.
\(\frac{\pi}{2}\): odd multiple of \(\frac{\pi}{2}\), undefined.
\(\pi = 2 \times \frac{\pi}{2}\): even multiple, theek hai, \(\tan\pi = 0\).
\(-\frac{3\pi}{2}\): odd multiple, undefined.
To \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(-\frac{3\pi}{2}\) domain se bahar hain.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Degrees mein yaad rakhein: \(\tan\theta\) undefined hai \(90^{\circ}, 270^{\circ}, -90^{\circ}, \ldots\) par, aur \(\cot\theta\) undefined hai \(0^{\circ}, 180^{\circ}, 360^{\circ}, \ldots\) par. Aasan test: tangent wahan fail hota hai jahan \(\cos\theta = 0\), aur cotangent wahan jahan \(\sin\theta = 0\). Kyun? Kyun ke \(\tan\theta = \frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\) aur \(\cot\theta = \frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Dono lists ulat dena: tangent \(Y\)-axis par fail hota hai (\(x = 0\)), cotangent \(X\)-axis par (\(y = 0\)). Bachne ka tareeqa: fraction likh kar denominator dekhiye.
2. Cotangent mein \(\theta = 0\) bhool jana: \(n = 0\) se \(0\pi = 0\), aur \(\cot 0\) undefined hai.
3. Tangent ki range sine ki tarah \([-1, 1]\) likh dena. Tangent ki koi hadd nahin; \(\tan 89^{\circ}\) hi 57 se zyada hai.
4. \((2n+1)\frac{\pi}{2}\) ki jagah \(n\frac{\pi}{2}\) likh dena. Is se \(0\) aur \(\pi\) bhi nikal jate hain, jahan tangent bilkul theek hai.
